roles.name: Security
roles.required_authority: Named independent security specialist or organization security authority
roles.separation: Must not be the implementation author or approver of this review

roles.name: Data Model
roles.required_authority: Named identity/data-model specialist with SQLite/schema and migration authority
roles.separation: Must independently review B2/B3 data invariants

roles.name: Operations
roles.required_authority: Named operations owner or infrastructure specialist
roles.separation: Must independently verify topology, backup/restore and migration boundaries

roles.name: Privacy/Legal
roles.required_authority: Qualified privacy/legal reviewer assigned by the organization
roles.separation: Must not rely on engineering source inspection as independent legal evidence

roles.name: Provider Compatibility
roles.required_authority: Named provider owner or protocol interoperability authority
roles.separation: Must verify exact issuer, subject, claim and lifecycle behavior

roles.name: Release Authority
roles.required_authority: Named organization release authority with change-control authority
roles.separation: Must verify all prior gates and exact deployment scope
